name: Ultralight Grey Oak Accent, Black Felt
summary: Grey oak real wood veneer laminated on black recycled felt, 9mm thick, with a continuous face and no rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec overrides photo estimates: two 300mm (11.811in) pitches, each a continuous 297mm (11.693in) veneer face with no internal slats and a 3mm (0.118in) wide, 1.5mm deep 90-degree V reveal at joins, on 9mm black felt; the tile spans 600 x 750mm without horizontal end joints. Grey oak tone is sampled from main.jpg, rather than the spec's White Oak/Walnut finish names or other gallery colors; the spec says Accent cannot wrap a column (standard UltraLight Slat is required), and 94.49in panels do not span a 10ft wall height.
